import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quick_select_precond (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  k < v.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def qsInsert (x : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: qsInsert x ys

def qsSort : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => qsInsert x (qsSort xs)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def quick_select (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) (h_precond : quick_select_precond v k) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let _h : quick_select_precond v k := h_precond
  (qsSort v.toList).getD k 0
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quick_select_postcond (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) (result : Int) (h_precond : quick_select_precond v k) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  ∃ sorted : List Int,
    sorted.length = v.size ∧
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) sorted ∧
    sorted.getD k 0 = result ∧
    sorted.Perm v.toList
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma qsInsert_length (x : Int) : ∀ xs : List Int,
    (qsInsert x xs).length = xs.length + 1
  | [] => by
      simp [qsInsert]
  | y :: ys => by
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simp [qsInsert, h]
      · simp [qsInsert, h, qsInsert_length x ys]

lemma qsInsert_perm (x : Int) : ∀ xs : List Int,
    (qsInsert x xs).Perm (x :: xs)
  | [] => by
      simp [qsInsert]
  | y :: ys => by
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simpa [qsInsert, h]
      ·
        simpa [qsInsert, h] using
          ((List.Perm.cons y (qsInsert_perm x ys)).trans (List.Perm.swap y x ys).symm)

lemma qsInsert_mem {a x : Int} (xs : List Int) :
    a ∈ qsInsert x xs ↔ a = x ∨ a ∈ xs := by
  have hmem : a ∈ qsInsert x xs ↔ a ∈ x :: xs := (qsInsert_perm x xs).mem_iff
  simpa using hmem

lemma qsInsert_pairwise (x : Int) : ∀ xs : List Int,
    List.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) xs →
    List.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (qsInsert x xs)
  | [], _ => by
      simp [qsInsert]
  | y :: ys, hs => by
      have hs_simp := hs
      simp at hs_simp
      rcases hs_simp with ⟨hRel, hTail⟩
      by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
      ·
        have hxRel : ∀ z ∈ y :: ys, x ≤ z := by
          intro z hz
          have hz' : z = y ∨ z ∈ ys := by
            simpa using hz
          rcases hz' with rfl | hzys
          · exact hxy
          · exact le_trans hxy (hRel z hzys)
        simpa [qsInsert, hxy] using
          (List.Pairwise.cons hxRel hs)
      ·
        have hyx : y ≤ x := by omega
        have hyRel : ∀ z ∈ qsInsert x ys, y ≤ z := by
          intro z hz
          have hz' : z = x ∨ z ∈ ys :=
            (qsInsert_mem (a := z) (x := x) ys).1 hz
          rcases hz' with rfl | hzys
          · exact hyx
          · exact hRel z hzys
        simpa [qsInsert, hxy] using
          (List.Pairwise.cons hyRel (qsInsert_pairwise x ys hTail))

lemma qsSort_length : ∀ xs : List Int,
    (qsSort xs).length = xs.length
  | [] => by
      simp [qsSort]
  | x :: xs => by
      simp [qsSort, qsInsert_length, qsSort_length xs]

lemma qsSort_perm : ∀ xs : List Int,
    (qsSort xs).Perm xs
  | [] => by
      simp [qsSort]
  | x :: xs => by
      exact (qsInsert_perm x (qsSort xs)).trans (List.Perm.cons x (qsSort_perm xs))

lemma qsSort_pairwise : ∀ xs : List Int,
    List.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (qsSort xs)
  | [] => by
      simp [qsSort]
  | x :: xs => by
      exact qsInsert_pairwise x (qsSort xs) (qsSort_pairwise xs)

lemma qsSort_sorted : ∀ xs : List Int,
    List.Sorted (fun a b : Int => a ≤ b) (qsSort xs)
  | xs => by
      simpa [List.Sorted] using qsSort_pairwise xs

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem quick_select_postcond_satisfied (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) (h_precond : quick_select_precond v k) :
    quick_select_postcond v k (quick_select v k h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨qsSort v.toList, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [qsSort_length]
  · exact qsSort_sorted v.toList
  · rfl
  · exact qsSort_perm v.toList
  -- !benchmark @end proof
